mapper.select: SELECT ur.USER_ROUTE_ID AS userRouteId, ur.USER_ID AS userId, ur.SOURCE_AI_ROUTE_ID AS sourceAiRouteId, ur.USER_ROUTE_TITLE AS userRouteTitle, ur.USER_ROUTE_DAYS AS userRouteDays, ur.USER_ROUTE_REGION AS userRouteRegion, ur.USER_ROUTE_STARTDATE AS userRouteStartdate, ur.USER_ROUTE_ENDDATE AS userRouteEnddate, ur.USER_ROUTE_SAVED AS userRouteSaved FROM tblUserRoute ur WHERE ur.USER_ROUTE_ID = #{userRouteId}

SELECT s.USER_ROUTE_STOP_ID AS userRouteStopId, s.USER_ROUTE_ID AS userRouteId, s.USER_ROUTE_DAY AS userRouteDay, s.USER_ROUTE_STOP_ORDER AS userRouteStopOrder, s.USER_ROUTE_LAT AS userRouteLat, s.USER_ROUTE_LONG AS userRouteLong, s.USER_ROUTE_DESCRIPTION AS userRouteDescription, s.ACTIVITY_CODE AS activityCode, s.DURATION_IN_MINUTES AS durationInMinutes, s.RESTAURANT_CATEGORY AS restaurantCategory, s.TRANSPORTATION_MODE AS transportationMode FROM tblUserRouteStop s WHERE s.USER_ROUTE_ID = #{userRouteId} ORDER BY s.USER_ROUTE_DAY, s.USER_ROUTE_STOP_ORDER
